mzar.review:
Mzar pros and cons
pros -
1. easygoing (Consider students problem )
2. Gives suggestion question before mid and final and exam e suggestion thekei question dibe
3. she might ask quiz e 10 or 20 ta question, the section decide how many question they wanna answer, so make sure the section selects 10 question for quiz,
4. instantly quiz er marks diye dibe so you dont need to worry about marks also final chara shob marks e upload kore dey.
5. Deserving grade
Cons -
1. She will not curve even a single marks neither bonus questions will be given in mid or final
2. Quiz er din class er first ei quiz nibe so if you late for 10-15 min you miss the quiz. No consideration about it because quiz sesh hoilei answer bole dey, so make sure you are not late in class
mzar so good made me wanted to switch to mic
